HediffDef.label: NPC Package: lite need disabler
HediffDef.description: This is a debug hediff that disables a pawn's various unimportant needs.\n\nThis hediff will be removed if the pawn is downed or killed.

HediffDef.Name: SWCPNPCPackageHediff_needdisabler
HediffDef.label: NPC Package: need disabler
HediffDef.description: This is a debug hediff that disables a pawn's hunger, rest, and various other needs.\n\nThis hediff will be removed if the pawn is downed or killed.

HediffDef.Name: SWCPNPCPackageHediff_boredguard
HediffDef.label: NPC Package: bored guard
HediffDef.description:
This is a debug hediff that disables a various needs and sets stats according to a specific role.

This pawn has the role of a bored, inattentive guard.

This hediff will be removed if the pawn is downed or killed.
